verdict.rationale: Relay documents outgoing international wires that can send same-day, with the exact delivery estimate shown before confirming. Independent coverage says pricing is straightforward: a flat $10 per outgoing international transfer, waived on Relay Pro. Nothing in the pack shows payments can be sent in the recipient's local currency or that FX rates and markups are disclosed. missing for 10: evidence of sending in local/foreign currencies, FX rate and markup transparency, first-party fee disclosure for international payments.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees

citations.quote: wires (domestic and international) can send same-day. You'll see the exact delivery estimate before confirming.
Pricing is straightforward - although not exactly affordable at $10 per outgoing transaction. If you're on the Relay Pro plan, the fee is waived.
